seoPages.title: Interface & Device Physics for Emerging Electronics
seoPages.description: Min Jong Lee studies molecular interfaces, defects, ionic dynamics, and device reliability across emerging memory, optoelectronic, and flexible electronic platforms.

seoPages.title: About
seoPages.description: Min Jong Lee is an integrated M.S.–Ph.D. researcher in electronic devices, materials, and interface physics at Korea University.

seoPages.title: Research
seoPages.description: Research on molecular interfaces, memristive and chiral optoelectronic memory, and flexible-electronics variability, with integration as a future direction.

seoPages.title: Projects
seoPages.description: Research projects in emerging memory, interfaces, and stretchable interconnects, with verified roles in academic and industry–academic programs.
